conviction_note: Q3 is almost all public: the company fixed 92% of shipping days at ~US$88k and pre-released the trading segment (US$118m net). The move sits in two new lines, the Q4 TCE guide and the Q3 dividend. Both should come out large, because Baltic VLGC spot TCEs were US$190-247k/day in the week to 20 Nov. But the market can see those indices, and Dorian fell ~7% on record results on 5 Nov. So abs_move is 4.5 for a new-period guide on a pre-released quarter, and p_up is 55, which gives +0.45. The findings sum to +1.2 because the Q4-guide finding is sized at full size on its own, and the peer-reaction veto acts on p_up rather than on that finding.

findings.finding: The Q4 2026 TCE guide is the main new line and should step up sharply from Q3's ~US$88k/day. Baltic VLGC spot TCEs in the week to 20 Nov were US$246,826/day (BLPG1 Ras Tanura-Chiba), US$204,608 (BLPG2) and US$189,690 (BLPG3), with US Gulf sentiment 'strengthened'. The company's own August FFA read for the rest of 2026 was ~US$180k against only 41% TC cover at US$44.1k plus 4% FFA at US$48k. On 23 Nov Iran asserted control over Hormuz and struck Bahrain, which lowers the near-term odds of a reopening.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (guide raised from US$54k actual to an US$81k Q2 guide): -0.16% on the day. Q2 2026 (US$88k Q3 guide): -0.53%. A higher next-quarter TCE guide has not lifted this stock on results day in 2026; Q1 2024 is the large positive case (+10.91%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The Baltic indices and the FFA curve are public and the four covering analysts model Q4 from them. If the market fully believed a US$120k+ Q4, the stock would not be down 11% over 20 sessions while spot sits near records. The residual is the exact fixed share and rate and how much of the near-record November spot was locked in, which only the company knows. The size is small because the direction is inferable from public indices.
findings.independence: Company FFA read and coverage in the Q2 release (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=681096); Hormuz escalation 23 Nov (https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/iran-asserts-control-over-hormuz-as-strikes-on-bahrain-saudi-arabia-escalate/); peer Dorian's Jul-Sep TCE of US$96,990/day (https://www.bairdmaritime.com/shipping/tankers/gas/dorian-lpg-reports-record-profit)

findings.finding: Q3 dividend at the 100%-of-shipping-NPAT policy should rise well above Q2's US$0.95. The Q3 fixture rate is ~19% above Q2's guide (US$88k vs US$81k at 85%), and the BW Elm gain (~US$36m, 100% basis) falls in Q3. Q1 also carried a trading capital return on top of the policy (US$0.11), and Q3's trading net profit was US$118m, so a top-up has precedent.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 payout above policy (US$0.67 incl. US$0.11 trading return): -0.16%. Q2 2026 US$0.95 at 100% of shipping NPAT: -0.53%. Dividend surprises have not moved this name much on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The policy is public, so analysts project roughly the shipping NPAT. Two parts are unknown: whether gains count toward payout and whether trading profit is returned. The other side of the risk is that the ~US$940m newbuild programme and the September convertible could lead the board to hold back. If a top-up were expected, the stock would not have drifted down into the print.

findings.finding: The closest peer sold off on a record print. Dorian LPG reported a third straight record quarter (TCE US$96,990/day, net income US$213.9m) on 4 Nov and fell from US$49.43 to US$46.08 (-6.8%) on 5 Nov. BWLPG fell with it (220.2 to 210.2 NOK, then 203.6). Coverage of the call says management warned rates could fall 'very fast' if Hormuz reopens. The sector is selling record results on duration risk, and BW LPG's own Q2 outlook flagged the same reopening risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BWLPG traded down 4.5% and 3.1% on the two sessions after Dorian's print (Yahoo daily closes https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BWLPG.OL?range=3mo&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The read-across is priced in BWLPG's own November drop. What is not priced is whether BW LPG management repeats the cautious framing on its own call (14:00 CET, inside the window). A record Q4 guide paired with 'rates could fall fast' is how Dorian's day went.
findings.independence: Dorian price series (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/LPG?range=2mo&interval=1d); BW LPG's own Q2 outlook on Hormuz reopening narrowing the arbitrage (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=681096)

'The move is in the guide' (guidance findings 11/17 on sign): the Q4 TCE guide finding moved from +0.8 to +1.2, and abs_move_pct from 3.5 to 4.5 because the release carries a new-period TCE guide, not only a pre-released quarter
